What Channel + opens when it starts

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your Channel + backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
Channel + player

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so Channel + finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
Channel + could not work out how many channels this provider allows.
Resolve all Channel + domain lookups through a custom DNS server.

If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, Channel + stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, Channel + still falls back to stereo and tells you.
This device could not be reached. On it, open Channel + → More → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
